title: Import broker needs the consignee to appoint it before processing

plan.situation: Customs broker Ossmere Trade Desk cannot process DL-046 until the consignee, Celand Arc Imports, appoints it. Under the broker's stated process, the registered authorised signatory has to accept a mandate for this shipment in the verified business portal. The consignee's account administrator says the director Mara Vesk is that signatory. They cannot sign from their operator account and have asked the desk to ask her to complete the mandate.

facts.fact: DL-046 is waiting for a consignee mandate. The broker's procedure needs the registered authorised signatory to accept a mandate for this shipment in the verified business portal. No passport or banking credentials are needed.
Mara Vesk, director, is the authorised signatory for broker appointment on DL-046, and her verified business-portal channel is active.
The administrator's operator account cannot sign the mandate.
The broker has not been appointed yet.
No customs or clearance deadline is recorded.

missing_information: Whether Mara Vesk accepts the mandate for DL-046 in the business portal
Any customs storage or clearance deadline for DL-046 (none recorded)
risk_flags: Authority: only the registered signatory can appoint the broker. The desk is passing on a request and is not granting or assuming the appointment.
Credentials: no passwords, one-time codes, passport or bank details will be asked for or stored, and no links will be sent.
The register excerpt came from the administrator. The message goes only to Mara Vesk's verified business-portal channel, so she confirms it herself.

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: Event 002: the consignee names its authorised signatory and asks the desk to contact her. The desk has made no earlier promise.

plan.decision_summary: Ask Mara Vesk, the registered authorised signatory, through her verified Business portal channel to decide whether to accept the Ossmere Trade Desk mandate for DL-046. The draft is held for human approval because it involves signing authority.
plan.rationale: Only the consignee's authorised signatory can appoint the broker, and her verified business-portal channel is active. Asking her directly gets the single input that is blocking DL-046. The message is a request, not an instruction, and it asks for no credentials. Because this involves a mandate and signing authority, the hard human gate applies.

actions.to_role: Director and authorised signatory, Celand Arc Imports
actions.subject: DL-046: customs broker mandate waiting for your decision
actions.body:
Dear Ms Vesk,

Shipment DL-046 for Celand Arc Imports is waiting for customs processing. The customs broker, Ossmere Trade Desk, cannot act on it until it is appointed. Under its procedure, the registered authorised signatory has to accept a mandate for this shipment in your verified business portal. Your company's account register lists you as that signatory for DL-046.

If you agree to appoint Ossmere Trade Desk for DL-046, please review and accept the mandate in your business portal. If you do not agree, or you are not the right signatory, please reply here so we can tell the broker.

This is a request for your decision. Nothing has been signed or approved on your behalf. We will never ask you for passwords, one-time codes, passport or banking details, and we have not included any links.

Kind regards,
Iona Quill
Rivet Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Get the authorised signatory's decision on appointing the broker, which is the only thing blocking DL-046.

not_doing: Not signing, accepting or treating the mandate as granted, because only Mara Vesk can do that.
Not telling the broker it is appointed. That waits until the mandate is recorded.
Not asking for or storing any credentials or identity documents, and not sending links.
Not promising a clearance or delivery time, because the broker has given none.
Not writing to the administrator's operator account to sign, because it cannot sign.
plan.follow_up: Check the Business portal for Mara Vesk's reply or acceptance. Ask Ossmere Trade Desk by Email to confirm that it has received the mandate before treating the broker as appointed. The record gives no deadline, so no timed follow-up is set. If she does not reply, or she disputes that she is the signatory, refer the matter to the supervisor queue.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Ask Mara Vesk, the registered authorised signatory, through her verified Business portal channel to decide whether to accept the Ossmere Trade Desk mandate for DL-046. The draft is held for human approval because it involves signing authority.

issues.problem: The follow-up has no set time. 'If she does not reply' gives no checkpoint, so a non-response could go unnoticed even though the shipment is blocked.
issues.fix: Set an internal review checkpoint, for example the next business day. If there is no acceptance or reply by then, check with Ossmere Trade Desk whether a storage or clearance deadline applies, and refer the case to the supervisor if needed.

review.summary: The plan asks only Mara Vesk, the registered signatory, through her verified business-portal channel to decide whether to accept the broker's mandate. It does not present the mandate as granted, asks for no credentials, includes no links, makes no promises and sticks to the record. The only issue is minor: the follow-up has no set time.
